citeinfo.title: Spatially disaggregated 1 km rasters of monthly and annual thermoelectric power plant water consumption and withdrawal estimates for the conterminous United States, 2008 to 2020.

descript.abstract:
This data release provides gridded estimates of the monthly and annual water consumption and withdrawal of thermoelectric power plants in the conterminous United States, 2008 to 2020. The grid has 1000-meter cells.
The estimates were produced by a footprint-based method. The footprint of a plant is the area covered by its OpenStreetMap features, obtained through the Overpass API. Plant codes and point locations, mainly from the 2020 EIA-860 form, were used to find the footprints. The reported monthly water use of each plant was apportioned to the 1000-meter cells, in proportion to the footprint area in each cell. The annual estimates are the day-weighted mean of the monthly estimates.
The grid, coordinate reference system, and HUC-2-derived land extent are the same as those of the HUC-12-based disaggregation of irrigation and public-supply water use. Thus the two products align to identical grid cells.
descript.purpose: To provide fine-resolution (1000-meter) gridded estimates of thermoelectric power plant water use across the conterminous United States. These estimates support analyses that require water use information on a grid, instead of at plant point locations. The plant-level water use statistics were spatially disaggregated with a plant-footprint proportional allocation approach.
descript.supplinf:
This data release provides monthly and annual GeoTIFFs, with these names: <year>-<month>-consumption.tif <year>-<month>-withdrawal.tif <year>-annual-consumption.tif <year>-annual-withdrawal.tif <month> is the two-digit calendar month (01-12), and <year> ranges from 2008 to 2020.
Every raster in this data release has a single band ("Value"). The band reports water use in million gallons per day (MGD) per 1000-meter grid cell. The rasters are 64-bit floating point, with lossless DEFLATE compression. NaN is the nodata value. The entity and attribute overview lists the cells that are NaN. See the accompanying data dictionary (data_dictionary.csv) for the field descriptions and value ranges.
Ancillary data: OpenStreetMap plant footprints (obtained through the Overpass API, as the OpenStreetMap data were on 2026-03-25) and power plant point locations. The method uses them directly for proportional allocation within each plant, not as predictors.
Source data: published_monthly_thermoelectric_water_use_estimates_2008-2020.csv (monthly power-plant water consumption and withdrawal). Source: Galanter, A.E., Gorman Sanisaca, L.E., Skinner, K.D., Harris, M.A., Diehl, T.H., Chamberlin, C.A., Mccarthy, B.A., Halper, A.S., Niswonger, R., Stewart, J.S., Markstrom, S.L., Embry, I.A., and Worland, S.C., 2023, Thermoelectric-power water use reanalysis for the 2008-2020 period by power plant, month, and year for the conterminous United States: U.S. Geological Survey data release, https://doi.org/10.5066/P9ZE2FVM. That release builds on condenser-duty estimates from a second release: Gorman Sanisaca, L.E., Galanter, A.E., Skinner, K.D., Harris, M.A., Diehl, T.H., Halper, A.S., Mohs, T.G., Roland, V.L., Stewart, J.S., and Niswonger, R., 2023, Thermoelectric-power condenser duty estimates by month and cooling type for use to calculate water use by power plant for the 2008-2020 reanalysis period for the conterminous United States: U.S. Geological Survey data release, https://doi.org/10.5066/P9XG876W. te_plants.csv (thermoelectric plant codes and locations, https://www.sciencebase.gov/catalog/item/63adc826d34e92aad3ca5af4). 2___Plant_Y2020.xlsx (2020 EIA-860 plant codes and locations). Watershed Boundary Dataset (WBD) HU-2 boundaries of regions 1 to 18 (template grid).
https://github.com/jim245/thermoelectric-spatial-disaggregation

attracc.attraccr: The method allocates the reported total of each plant to the cells that its footprint intersects. Thus the cell sums of each plant equal the reported plant total. The exception is the part of a footprint outside the land cells of the template grid, which gets no water. Two of the 1,341 plants have such a part, at most 0.45 percent of the footprint area. The water in these parts is at most 0.0004 percent of the national monthly total in any month from 2008 to 2020. Over all plant-months, it is 0.00006 percent of the consumption and 0.000003 percent of the withdrawal. No independent accuracy assessment was performed.

dataqual.logic: No formal logical accuracy tests were conducted.

horizpa.horizpar: No formal positional accuracy tests were conducted.

vertacc.vertaccr: No formal positional accuracy tests were conducted.

procstep.procdesc: HUC boundary acquisition and template raster generation: Watershed Boundary Dataset (WBD) HU-2 boundaries of regions 1 to 18 were obtained. The WBD files were downloaded on 2026-09-21. The source supplies only the latest WBD release. The boundaries were reprojected to an Albers Equal Area projection (EPSG:5070). A 1000-meter template raster was generated from their combined extent. A cell is a land cell if it touches a HU-2 region. This template defines the pixel grid, transform, coordinate reference system, and land cells of every raster. It is identical to the template of the HUC-12-based disaggregation of irrigation and public-supply water use.

Thermoelectric power plant geometry acquisition: The point location of each plant was taken from the 2020 EIA-860 form. Plants with no location in that form (for example, plants retired before 2020) used the location in te_plants.csv. The locations of four plants were corrected by hand. The Overpass API supplied the OpenStreetMap features, as they were on 2026-03-25. For most plants, the footprint is the union of the OpenStreetMap features that have the plant's EIA code in their ref:US:EIA tag. For a hand-selected list of plants, the footprint is instead the union of the power-plant features within a plant-specific radius of the point location. For 39 plants on this list, no search was done. Where no footprint was found or no search was done, a circle centered on the plant's point location was used. Its area is the median area of the footprints that were found. The query run did not include 112 plants. Each of these plants also got a circle, whose area is the median area of the footprints of the query run, circles included.

Thermoelectric water use statistics preparation: The reported monthly power-plant water consumption and withdrawal estimates are in million gallons per day (see supplinf). The estimates of the plants in te_plants.csv were joined to the plant footprints by EIA plant code.

Thermoelectric footprint disaggregation: This step used each power plant, month, and year with nonzero reported consumption or withdrawal. The reported value was apportioned to template grid cells, in proportion to the fraction of the total footprint area of the plant in each cell. Thus the sum across all intersected cells equals the reported plant total for that month. The part of a footprint outside the land cells of the template grid gets no water. Land cells that intersect no plant footprint were assigned a value of 0. Cells outside the land cells were held at nodata (NaN).

Thermoelectric monthly-to-annual aggregation: Annual consumption and withdrawal rasters were produced for each year as the cell-by-cell day-weighted mean of the corresponding 12 monthly rasters. Thus the annual values are also in MGD.

overview.eaover: Units for all layers are million gallons per day (MGD) per 1000-meter grid cell. NaN is the nodata value. NaN marks the cells outside the land cells of the template grid, which are the cells that touch no WBD HU-2 region 1 to 18. All other cells have a value, which is 0 where no plant footprint intersects the cell. See data_dictionary.csv for the machine-readable version of this table.
